product.title: Cortech Chuckwagon Max Tray Transport Cart with Stainless Steel Base - C1720
product.body_html:
The Cortech Chuckwagon Max food delivery cart is a one piece, insulated food tray delivery cart with a metal base. Chuckwagon Max is designed for continuous, intensive use in the toughest environments. The Cart is a one piece plastic cart, the insulated walls provide maximum heat retention. The two sliding doors are insulated, and also have the option of adding a locking feature. When using Cortech trays, hot food stays hot and cold food stays cold. The Chuckwagon Max is an innovative, insulated meal tray delivery cart, making it the perfect fit for any Correctional Facility, Prison, or Jail's food delivery needs.

  • Accommodates any tray up to 9 1/2" x 14 1/2"
  • Raised top edge surface safely holds more trays, beverage servers and wash racks
  • Push/Pull Handles for easy navigation
  • Available options:
    • locking hasp doors (C1720LH)
    • tow & hitch (C1720TH)
    • tow & hitch and locking doors (C1720LHTH)
  • Highest quality non-marring kingpin-less casters with quick change out design
  • Holds 120 X-Trays, 120 Rock 2.0 Trays or 150 Rock trays! (sold separately)
  • Built-in wall bumpers
  • Solid one-piece sliding doors. No dangerous hinges
  • Available with locking hasp or without locking hasp for security
  • Manufactured to ISO Quality Standards in the USA.
  • Stainless steel base
  • Applications: Corrections, Behavioral Health, Mental Health, Law Enforcement, Schools and Universities, Military, Intensive-Use Environments, Recreational Facilities

About Cortech USA by Correctional Technologies:
Cortech USA (Correctional Technologies) manufactures products that are exceptionally durable, designed for use in compassionate and normative behavioral healthcare, corrections, law enforcement, heavy use commercial and industrial environments, parks and recreation, schools, universities, hospitals, emergency and homeless shelters, and other institutions and facilities where safety and durability matter. Cortech products are ideal for extreme use and intensive use environments.
